reservations.title: Reservations and requests
reservations.description: Animals held for a buyer, requests from the public page, and what the page shows.

reservations.cancelBody: The animal becomes free to sell again.
reservations.convertBody: A draft sale is created for this animal. Check and confirm it on the Sales page: payment is recorded there.
reservations.counterpartyNeeded: This buyer is not in the books yet. Choose the counterparty, or add one under Finance first.
reservations.emptyBody: Reserve an animal from its card or from the ready-for-sale list.

requests.reserveHint: Without a buyer from the books, the reservation carries the name and phone the visitor gave.
requests.closeBody: It stays in the list as closed. A new message from the same phone opens a new request.
requests.emptyBody: Requests sent from the public page appear here.

catalogue.showHint: Visitors see the species, breed, sex, age, weight and photo. Never the tag, the cost or health records.
catalogue.priceHint: Leave empty to show no price.
catalogue.listed: The animal is on the public page
catalogue.unlisted: The animal was taken off the public page
catalogue.emptyBody: Open an animal's card and switch on "Show on the public page".

public.title: Animals for sale
public.intro: Choose the animals you are interested in and leave your phone number. The farm will call you back.
public.notFoundBody: The farm has no public page at this address, or the page has been switched off.
public.emptyTitle: No animals are listed right now
public.emptyBody: You can still tell the farm what you are looking for.
public.tooMany: No more than {{max}} animals in one request.
public.name: Your name
public.wantedPlaceholder: For example: two animals of about 60 kg
public.consent: I agree that the farm keeps my name and phone number to answer this request.
public.successBody: The farm will contact you by phone.
public.errorPhone: Enter a phone number the farm can call
public.errorConsent: Your consent is needed to send the request
public.errorEmpty: Choose an animal or write what you are looking for
public.errorUnavailable: One of the chosen animals is no longer available. The list has been updated.
public.errorRate: Too many requests. Please try again in a few minutes.
public.errorGeneric: The request was not sent. Please try again.

orders.rejectTitle: Send the sale back to draft
orders.cancelConfirmedBody: Goods return to the warehouse, animals return to their herd, and the income entry is voided.
orders.confirmBody: Goods leave the warehouse, animals leave the herd and the income is recorded. A large sale needs a second person.
orders.pendingHint: This sale is above the approval threshold, so someone other than the person who entered it must confirm it. Nothing moves until then.
orders.withdrawalHint: Some animals are in a withdrawal period after treatment and cannot be sold until it ends.
orders.emptyBody: Create a document here when you sell produce or animals.

form.pickAccount: Choose a cash or bank account

prices.chartHint: Our price and the market price
